reviewers.coverage_notes: Confirmed all r7 PO issues resolved. Assessed scope change from control cutover to read-only cutover. Approved with conditions: document write-path alternatives before dogfood, add user-outcome metric. Five non-blocking issues, three suggestions.

Evaluated read-only UX patterns, approval task flow fragmentation, Syncing slot, targeted read-refresh feedback, and payload availability indicators. No blockers. Two non-blocking issues: approval button UX and ambiguous recovery guidance.

Evaluated visual state matrix, component reuse, Syncing placement in detail views, disabled approval visual coherence, and report payload indicator specificity. No blockers. Three non-blocking issues, three suggestions.

Performed targeted repo inspection. Confirmed GraphQL-only boundary is correct. One blocker: P043 reference contract conflict. Four non-blocking: schema fields, file boundary, approval contract, source governance. Confirms r7 command/MCP issues are superseded by operator correction.

consensus_areas: GraphQL-only read plane is the correct narrowing for a first visible cutover
No UI MCP and no UI GraphQL mutations is architecturally sound
Approval decision controls are the riskiest seam and need a tighter disabled-state contract
Operator write-path gap needs documentation before dogfood
Source artifact governance correctly marks r9 as governing

disagreement_areas.resolution: Architect blocker governs: proposal requires revision to reconcile P043 dependency contract with the GraphQL-only correction before Phase 1.
